summary: Rental extension end-to-end backend testing complete on PREVIEW backend (test Stripe key). All 12 pytest cases pass covering quote math, tier discount crossings, blackout dates, ownership/state guards, Pydantic validation, and live Stripe checkout session creation. Booking seeded directly in Mongo (per E1 instructions), auth via cookie/Bearer session from POST /api/auth/register. Tests use lowercase email (register lowercases). No backend code was modified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2925 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline; consider splitting extension/rentals/auth into separate routers.
In rental_extend_checkout (server.py:861), status 'active' is not part of the eligibility guard — anything not in {cancelled, completed} passes. Consider explicit allow-list to be safer.

_compute_extension_amount uses booking['price'] as the daily price. If any booking historically stored total-instead-of-daily in `price`, the extension math would be wrong. All current create paths look correct, but a Pydantic model on read would harden this.
extend/quote does not enforce a max new_days ceiling. Combined with additional_days<=30 this is fine, but there is no check against reasonable business ceiling (e.g. 60 days rental).
test_credentials: Ephemeral customer created via POST /api/auth/register (test_ext_<uuid>@example.com / TestPass123!). Auth uses session_token cookie / Bearer header. All test data cleaned up via module-scoped fixture teardown.
seed_data_creation: Bookings inserted directly into Mongo db.bookings with payment_status='paid', service_type='rental', item_id=<real /api/rentals id>, days>=2, price=<vehicle daily>, booking_date=today+7d (skipping Saturdays and existing site blackouts). Blackout test temporarily adds a date to db.rentals[vehicle].blackout_dates and restores it in a finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rental extension endpoints (quote + checkout) verified end-to-end on preview. Live-key verification will be done by user on production Namecheap VPS. If retesting: use lowercase email when seeding customer_email (server lowercases on register) and skip Saturday pickup days (weekly closed day validation is on other endpoints, not extend, but keeps seed sane).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial test failures were due to test fixture using mixed-case email while /api/auth/register normalizes to lowercase before storage; fixed by lowercasing email in fixture.
